subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should the WhatsApp phone-code work also be required to eliminate the manual gateway-restart 515 finalization workaround before this issue can close, or should that recovery behavior be split into a separate WhatsApp-owned fix?
rationale: The issue overlaps open phone-code PRs, but the report is specifically about recovery finalization after WhatsApp accepts a code; current main has only QR login plus a one-shot 515 retry, so automation cannot decide the product/API and live-proof boundary safely.

options.title: Require Recovery Proof In Phone-Code PR
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the active phone-code lane and require live proof that the phone-side Logging in / 515 phase reaches healthy linked status without an operator gateway restart.

options.title: Split A Narrow Recovery Fix
options.body: Let the phone-code PR focus on the login entrypoint and track this issue as a separate WhatsApp-owned 515/session finalization repair with its own live proof.

options.title: Treat The Restart As Documented Workaround
options.body: Maintain the gateway restart workaround as expected operator recovery and close only after maintainers explicitly accept that behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Recovery Proof In Phone-Code PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue tied to the active phone-code lane and require live proof that the phone-side Logging in / 515 phase reaches healthy linked status without an operator gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin/channel API, docs, and auth-session boundaries where the current blame and prior channel-auth history point to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
